The page is a demo/test page for **Zo co-browsing** — not real documentation.

Its content is a mock marketing layout: a nav header (Pricing, Features, Docs, About), a hero reading "Build Smarter with Zo," and three feature cards — Instant DuckDB Queries, Web Research Automation, and Custom Skill Builder — plus a footer with standard legal links.

So the main topic is **Zo's capabilities** (querying data, automating web research, building skills), presented as a placeholder page to test co-browsing navigation and interaction.
